name: Jitsi Meet
author: Jitsi Team
summary: Jitsi Meet is an open-source (Apache) WebRTC JavaScript application that uses Jitsi Videobridge to provide high quality, secure and scalable video conferences.

versions.release_notes:
This release updates Electron to 43.8.3, which removes trust for the certificate hierarchy involved in the October 2026 eMudhra intermediate CA key compromise (see https://blog.google/security/protecting-chrome-and-android-users-from-compromised-emudhra-intermediate-ca-certificates/). The desktop app ships its own root store, so updating is the only way to pick this up.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
